selection_basis.lower: 75 to 100 Hz adds 0.123 dB mean noise reduction but drops minimum Clean power retention from 97.081% to 92.768%.
selection_basis.upper: 4000 Hz is a conservative compromise: 3500 Hz adds 0.319 dB noise reduction, while high-frequency phonetic preservation is not established by total power.
selection_basis.order: Digital order 4 preserves more Clean power than order 2 and gives the highest mean and minimum spectral SNR change among tested orders at 75–4000 Hz.
